design_philosophy: High contrast for low-light warehouses, one-thumb workflow for gloved usage, instantaneous visual and haptic feedback, offline-first reliability.

scan_rectangle.corners: 4px width, 24px length, absolute positioning on corners

motion_and_haptics.scan_success: Heavy haptic feedback (ImpactFeedbackStyle.Heavy) + distinct success beep. Screen flash white for 50ms.
motion_and_haptics.scan_error: Double heavy haptic feedback + error buzz. Screen flash red.
motion_and_haptics.sheet_entrance: Spring animation (damping: 20, stiffness: 90) for bottom sheet pop-up.
motion_and_haptics.scan_line_loop: Continuous vertical translation with react-native-reanimated, easing linear, repeat infinitely.

MainScanScreen.layout: Full-screen camera underneath. Top bar: Sync status badge. Center: Focus rectangle. Bottom 30%: Black gradient overlay housing quick controls (Refresh/Flashlight toggles).
MainScanScreen.behavior: When an Order ID is detected, pause camera processing, trigger success haptic, and present ScanResultSheet over the bottom half.

ScanResultSheet.layout: Header: Massive Order ID (h1_scan_result) in Primary Color. Body: Customer Name, Phone, Product, Amount Due, Order Date laid out in a dense 2-column grid. Footer: 'Scan Next Package' (Primary Button), alongside icon buttons for Copy and Share.

SearchScreen.layout: Top: Giant search input (height 64px, large text). Center: Recent searches or search results list. Empty state: 'Type Order ID or Customer Name'.
SearchScreen.behavior: Real-time filtering. Keyboard dark appearance. Tapping a result opens the Result details.

SettingsScreen.layout: Form layout. Inputs for 'Google Sheet URL', 'Scan Region Size'. Use large text inputs and big toggle switches. Include a forced 'Manual Sync' button at the bottom.

HistoryScreen.layout: FlatList of recently scanned packages. Each row shows Order ID, Time Scanned, and Sync Status (Synced vs Pending). Row height 80px for easy tapping.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native app. Do NOT use web-only libraries like Tailwind CSS or Shadcn/ui unless you are using NativeWind. Prefer standard React Native StyleSheet if NativeWind is not pre-configured.
For the camera and OCR, utilize 'expo-camera'. Use its barcode scanning features or frame processing capabilities.
Implement the 'One-Thumb Workflow': Keep all primary interactive elements (buttons, inputs) large (minimum 60px height) and located in the bottom half of the screen.
Ensure 'expo-haptics' is integrated for tactile feedback on scan success.
For the Result screen, use a standard React Native Modal configured as a Bottom Sheet, or '@gorhom/bottom-sheet' if you install it.
Use standard dark mode colors as explicitly defined in the color_palette. Avoid pure white backgrounds to prevent warehouse glare.
Test IDs in React Native use the 'testID' prop, not 'data-testid'. Please map 'data-testid' conceptually to 'testID' in all RN components.
